name: MailCheck.ai / UserCheck domain check
operator: UserCheck (formerly MailCheck.ai; mailcheck.ai redirects to usercheck.com, terms under Singapore law)
tier_rationale: Identifiable service brand with public API documentation, published terms of service, a privacy policy, a data processing agreement and paid plans, operating since 2016 (validator.pizza -> mailcheck.ai -> UserCheck); the legal entity is not named on the terms page, so community rather than trusted (A8).

reliability.justification: Disposable/relay/public-domain classification plus domain age and MX facts from one curated database; a second opinion next to the offline lists.

error_markers.reason: MailCheck.ai/UserCheck: too many requests (status 429 inside the answer)
MailCheck.ai/UserCheck: request rejected (status 400 inside the answer)

domain.title: MailCheck.ai GET /domain/{domain} (domain only; the /email endpoint is never used)

terms.quote: Free Plan: Limited daily requests, no registration required
terms.reviewer: p1-G04-1 implementer (P088 C5: terms recorded per provider before use)

domain.notes: Research C0214 (verified_live 200, Cloudflare). Terms (Last Updated July 9, 2025, checked 2026-11-26): the free plan needs no registration, the acceptable-use clause forbids only unlawful purposes, spam/fraud and damaging the service (no commercial-use restriction), and s.12 adds:'You may not resell, sublicense, share, or redistribute UserCheck data or API results to third parties without our written agreement' - internal use only: results must not be shared outside the organisation as a dataset. Keyless requests are limited to 5 per hour per IP and then answer 429 with Retry-After up to an hour (rate-limits page). Only the normalised domain is sent (P088 C5); the JSON 'status' field is an error-in-200 marker.
